question.text: Ms. Anita Desai, CFO at Aravalli Long-Short Fund (Cat III onshore), is provisioning GST on management fees paid to the Investment Manager. The applicable GST rate per Chapter 14 is:

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook states that GST at the rate of 18% would be levied on investment management fees and trusteeship fees payable by the Fund to the Investment Manager and Trustee, respectively. GST is a direct cost to the fund and is borne by LPs through the NAV. The Trap: 5%, 12%, and 28% are other GST slabs used as distractors. Financial services default to the 18% standard rate. Note: A 2% management fee charged on AUM effectively costs LPs 2 x 1.18 = 2.36% per annum after GST, so models that quote the headline fee understate the NAV drag.
